description: When crosstab schema is published and how long it lasts. Saved dynamic crosstab QXtab (PARAMETERS pMin Long): QueryDef.Fields before pMin is assigned and after pMin = 0; Recordset.Fields after OpenRecordset, after MoveNext and after MoveLast; then a new pivot value 'new' is inserted with dbFailOnError, the recordset is requeried and its Fields reread, pMin = 3 with another Requery, and QueryDef.Fields read again. Also QueryDef.Fields of the fixed-heading QXFixed. Asks Count and Name/Type/Size at each point and the rows after each Requery.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-2-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
